qualifier: positive and negative regulation of assembly and maturation
name: Regulation of autophagosome assembly and maturation
rationale: All members concern phagophore targeting and up/down regulation of autophagosome assembly or maturation (including xenophagy), whereas confusables centre on lysosomal fusion or cargo-selective autophagy types.

qualifier: initiation, elongation braking, termination and R-loop processing
name: Regulation of RNA polymerase II initiation, elongation and termination
rationale: Members regulate Pol II transcription from preinitiation through elongation to termination and R-loop resolution (with chromatin/transcription BTM modules), while confusables add Pol I/III, rRNA, HIV elongation or RNA processing.

qualifier: endothelial, perivascular and platelet compartments
name: Endothelial, perivascular and platelet adhesion gene modules
rationale: The annotated members share endothelial morphogenesis, endothelial-matrix and cadherin adhesion, perivascular stroma and platelet/megakaryocyte signalling modules (several motif-only modules are uninformative), distinguishing it from smooth-muscle/shear-stress, ER and fibroblast confusables.

core: Viral life cycle in host cells
qualifier: entry, genome replication, protein maturation and assembly
name: Viral entry, genome replication, protein maturation and assembly
rationale: All members describe steps of viral infection cycles (attachment, entry, replication, translation, protein maturation, assembly/release) across SARS-CoV, dengue, RSV, influenza, HIV and HCMV, unlike confusables centred on interferon innate immunity or host restriction/nucleic-acid editing.

qualifier: dendritic cell and monocyte enriched
name: Leukocyte surface signatures, dendritic cell and monocyte enriched
rationale: Members are cell-surface/receptor signatures of dendritic cells, monocytes, plasma and T cells (plus butyrophilin and exosome assembly), while confusables are defined by lipid or MHC class II antigen presentation or T cell costimulation.

qualifier: HSF1-driven, with mitochondrial and autophagic chaperone control
name: HSF1 heat shock chaperone response and protein refolding
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation/attenuation, heat acclimation, protein refolding, UPRmt and chaperone control of mitochondrial targeting and chaperone-mediated autophagy, unlike confusables on ER UPR/chaperonins, stress granules or mitochondrial import.

qualifier: ribbon disassembly/reassembly and membrane tubulation
name: Golgi ribbon disassembly, reassembly and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly, reassembly, positioning and membrane tubulation/budding, whereas confusables emphasise COPI vesicle traffic, Rho GTPase cycles or constitutive secretion.

qualifier: metabolism and uptake regulation
name: Regulation of catecholamine metabolism and neurotransmitter uptake
rationale: Members regulate dopamine/catecholamine synthesis and metabolism, neurotransmitter uptake and secretion and spontaneous synaptic transmission, unlike confusables focused on SLC6 transporter defects or dopamine receptor signalling.

qualifier: AKT-FOXO and p53, fructose bisphosphate and lactate
name: AKT-FOXO and p53 regulation of glycolysis and lactate production
rationale: Members join AKT-FOXO/p53/mTORC1 signalling with fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation of glycolysis, fermentation and lactate synthesis, distinguishing them from hypoxia/HIF, NRF2 or plain glycolysis confusables.

qualifier: prostate and salivary gland branching
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signalling in prostate and salivary gland branching
rationale: Members cover reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling, branching and gland epithelial differentiation in prostate, salivary gland and male genitalia, while confusables are lung, female reproductive tract or pancreas/kidney development.

qualifier: iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria
name: Inherited iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria transporter defects
rationale: All three members are proline/glycine transporter defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria, unlike confusables on cystinuria, hypouricemia, hexose malabsorption or Hartnup disorder.

qualifier: post-translational control of PD-L1 in tumor immunity
name: Neddylation and post-translational control of PD-L1 stability
rationale: Members combine cullin neddylation/deneddylation and COP9 signalosome with PD-L1 glycosylation, trafficking and degradation affecting T cell anti-tumor responses, unlike confusables on PD-L1 transcription, general ubiquitination or viral Nef/Vpu.

qualifier: renal sodium and transepithelial chloride transport
name: Osmotic stress response and renal sodium-chloride transport
rationale: Members are hypo/hyperosmotic and osmosensory responses plus renal sodium and transepithelial chloride transport, while confusables centre on potassium handling, SLC12/SLC9 disorders or aldosterone/salt responses.

Members mix bacterial toxin uptake (anthrax, diphtheria), leishmania WNT5 damping, SARS therapeutics, RHO-activated NADPH oxidase and CD163 anti-inflammatory response, sharing no specific biological process beyond broad host defence.

qualifier: glycosylase excision, alkylation reversal and active demethylation
name: Glycosylase excision, alkylation reversal and active DNA demethylation
rationale: Members span DNA glycosylase recognition/cleavage, ALKBH/MGMT direct alkylation reversal, NEIL3 crosslink resolution and TET/TDG demethylation, whereas confusables are BER gap-filling steps or defective OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 variants.

qualifier: suppressing VEGF/FGF production and endothelial growth
name: Anti-angiogenic suppression of VEGF/FGF production and endothelial growth
rationale: Members restrain angiogenesis by lowering VEGF/FGF production, FGF chemotaxis and endothelial proliferation while promoting endothelial apoptosis and activation, unlike pro-angiogenic, VEGFR-signalling or vascular remodelling confusables.

qualifier: IL-12/IL-10 families and type I/III interferons
name: IL-12/IL-10 family cytokine and type I/III interferon signalling
rationale: Members are IL-12, IL-23, IL-27, IL-35, IL-10 and IL-20 family signalling with type III interferon and interferon-alpha response modules, distinct from IL-17/33, IL-15/21, IL-37 or IFN-gamma confusables.

qualifier: IL-2/7/9/3/5 and FLT3 with CBL regulation
name: STAT5-activating interleukin and FLT3 signalling with CBL regulation
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-3 and IL-5 receptor signalling, STAT5 activation and FLT3/G-CSF signalling with CBL-mediated attenuation, unlike IL-15/21, EPO/TPO or IL-6/CSF1 confusables.

qualifier: calcineurin-NFAT and cell size control
name: Calcineurin-NFAT control of cardiomyocyte hypertrophy and cell size
rationale: Members regulate cardiac muscle cell growth, adaptation and size, sarcomere organization and calcineurin-NFAT signalling, whereas confusables concern skeletal muscle growth, atrophy or regeneration.

qualifier: thrombin, ADP, prostanoid and GPVI receptors
name: Platelet thrombin, ADP, prostanoid and GPVI receptor signalling
rationale: Members are platelet receptor pathways (PAR thrombin, P2Y1/P2Y12, thromboxane/prostacyclin, GPVI, LDL sensitization), unlike confusables on G12/13-Rho, Rap1, adhesion or degranulation.

qualifier: plus host silencing of endogenous retroelements
name: Retroviral DNA integration and host silencing of retroelements
rationale: Members cover HIV pre-integration import, integration, 2-LTR/autointegration circles and APOBEC3G restriction together with HUSH and KRAB-ZFP retroelement silencing, which the HIV-entry and HCMV/latency confusables lack.

qualifier: TRKA and TRKC downstream effectors
name: TRKA and TRKC neurotrophin receptor downstream signalling
rationale: Members are NGF/TRKA (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, p38, CREB, PI3K) and NTF3/NTRK3 downstream cascades, distinguishing them from TRKB/BDNF and initial TRKA activation confusables.

qualifier: TREK, TRESK and calcium-activated K+ channels
name: TREK, TRESK and calcium-activated K+ channels in excitability
rationale: Members concern TREK/TRESK and Ca2+-activated K+ channels setting resting potential and hyperpolarization in neurons, urinary smooth muscle, hair cells and touch, unlike TASK/TWIK/THIK or KATP channel confusables.

qualifier: aggrephagy, ERAD and selective autophagic clearance
name: Misfolded protein clearance via aggrephagy, ERAD and selective autophagy
rationale: Members handle misfolded proteins through aggresome formation, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy, reticulophagy, ERAD regulation and E3/DUB activity, unlike folding-only or proteasomal ubiquitination confusables.

qualifier: AMPA, NMDA and kainate activation, clustering and trafficking
name: AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptor signalling and trafficking
rationale: Members cover activation, clustering, trafficking and downstream signalling of AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptors in excitatory transmission, unlike confusables on plasticity/memory-CREB, presynaptic or GABAergic regulation.
